head: LoopListen: shadowing app for iPhone loops a phrase until you get it
dek: LoopListen is a 99-cent iPhone and iPad app for listening practice: tap A and B to mark a part of a recording, and it repeats that part with pauses so you can say it back. It was #69 among paid Education apps on the US App Store on 19 November.
details: You can import audio, video and text files, slow the speed down and record your own voice to compare. It can also turn a document into speech; only that step uses an online voice service, after you tap Generate Audio. The listing says there's no account, no ads and no in-app purchases or subscriptions, and your files stay on the device. It came out on 12 October, needs iOS 17 and is made by a developer listed as 栋 梁.
means: If you're learning a language or practising a speech, you can drill one hard phrase again and again without dragging a slider back each time, for a one-time price.
todo: Search for LoopListen: A-B Loop Player on the App Store. It has no ratings yet, so read the listing before you buy.
